name: Saraswati
title: Goddess of Arts and Wisdom
description: Serene embodiment of music and wisdom in white and gold silks with a pearl tiara, white lotus blossoms, and a carved veena.
catchphrase: Purity of thought, harmony in architecture, clarity in expression.
